file_roles.evidence: MONGO_EXPORT_SERVER_PARAMETER(scriptingEngineInterruptIntervalMS, int, 1000) changed to default 0, a configuration default change.
Adds checks interruptInterval.count() > 0 so that interval 0 means disabled; an adaptation forced by the new default.

rationale: This is a request to change a default, not a defect report. The default change is a configuration change and the header change only makes the value 0 mean disabled. No code here was shown to be wrong logic.
notes: Not a bug report; the rubric has no clear role for a requested behaviour change. Alternative reading: cpp causal.
